channel.title: SRG+ Forms
channel.description: Updates of SRG+ Forms for Mac, downloaded outside the App Store.

item.description: - **Update at the top.** When a new version is ready, a blue Update button shows at the top right of the window. One click installs it and reopens the app; without a click it still installs when you quit.

- **Updates install by themselves.** The app checks every hour and installs a new version when you quit it. Opened from the disk image or Downloads, it first offers to move itself into Applications, where updates can reach it. - A partner sees a client's Forms only while the client shares Forms in SRG+ Connect.

SRG+ Forms for Mac, now as a direct download.
- Make forms, surveys and quizzes from a template or from scratch, each in its own window, and publish them in a click. - Share a form by link or QR code, or put it on your website. - See the results, read every answer and export them as CSV. - Send answers to SRG+ CRM, your team's email or any webhook. - Sign in with your SRG+ account, the same as in the App Store version. - The app keeps itself up to date: it checks for a new version every hour, or choose SRG+ Forms > Check for Updates.
